articles.title: Drug price mechanisms 'work against' buyers: Included Health CEO
articles.mainIdea: Drug price mechanisms 'work against' buyers: Included Health CEO
articles.summary: Yahoo Finance Video: Drug price mechanisms 'work against' buyers: Included Health CEO. President Trump unveiled his plans for sweeping healthcare policy on Thursday, which includes lowering drug prices and health insurance premiums as Americans continue to voice concerns of a growing affordability crisis. Included Health CEO Owen Tripp illustrates how the US healthcare system is far from operating at its best, commenting on drug price mechanisms and how he would fix the system. Also catch Owen Tripp's opinions on the integration of AI in medical systems and its exposure to personal data. Indeed created a methodology for finding the "best jobs for 2026," including specific criteria for positions that offer long-term mobility and job security. Indeed Director of Economic Research Laura Ullrich — one of the authors of this list — lays out the sectors and industries where these jobs are most apparent and the amount of training necessary for these types of jobs.
